syntheses.title: Contradiction Between End-to-End CNN Steering and Mid-Level RNN Trajectory Prediction Methods
syntheses.body: There is a contradiction in the autonomous driving methods regarding the level of processing and output. One method (claim e66d15a0-9347-5814-b053-1ff1dea8058d) uses a CNN that learns the entire processing pipeline to directly steer an automobile, producing steering commands from raw video input. In contrast, another method (claim cc49c2d4-b50d-5322-8525-304268249b24) employs ChauffeurNet, an RNN that takes mid-level input representations and outputs a driving trajectory, which is then translated into steering and acceleration commands by a controller. This represents a fundamental disagreement on whether end-to-end learning should produce direct control commands or intermediate trajectory outputs requiring further processing.
